instructions: Read every original event before selecting any move. Produce no ratings, scores, tags, winner or publication prose. Verify the primary-speaker scope exception against the complete source; if any condition remains uncertain, output {status:"source-gate-failed",reasons:[...]} instead. Do not silently add exclusions or modify the frozen motion.

Select 8–48 distinct load-bearing arguments, major direct replies and important concessions chronologically, using exactly 4–7 coherent topical sections. Let the source determine move count. No load-bearing omission or manufactured symmetry. Sections require unique semantic lowercase IDs, 2–10-word titles, integer weightPercent totaling 100 and source-specific weightRationale.

Each side needs 3–7 unique bridges with bridgeId, tier, burden, successCriterion; exactly one motion-tier bridge and at least one central and one subsidiary bridge. Each move links its own side’s bridge/tier with burdenContact.rationale. Importance is 1 supporting, 2 major or 3 load-bearing with importanceRationale, not a score forecast.

Each section must have at least one move per side and no more than four per side; three is ordinary. A fourth must have a source-specific >=40-character rationale establishing distinct, non-mergeable, independently assessable arguments in the coherent section. Do not shift one side merely to make counts pass.

Moves need claimSummary, reasonSummary, inferenceSummary:{premise,inference,conclusion}, sourceSpan:{startEvent,endEvent} in original zero-based indices. Use the smallest complete contiguous passage proving that speaker’s claim and reason. Controller supplies exact excerpt and timestamps. Target <=2200 characters; a genuinely necessary longer passage needs spanLengthRationale >=40 characters. Do not pad with opponent or audience speech.

quoteEligibleExactSpans contains only exact 3–18-word substrings within the selected source span. Preserve caption words. attributionConfidence and materialWordingConfidence must be high, medium or low with source-specific rationales. Uncertainty in either category must also make attributionConfidence below high, triggering later audio verification. Never interpret transcription mistakes as argumentative defects.

Constructive moves have moveKind:"constructive",respondsToIds:[],responseComponents:[]. Replies use moveKind:"reply", respond only to earlier selected move IDs and have responseComponents:[{targetMoveId,component,description}]. No reply link may target excluded material; do not select a host-dependent answer under another role.

selectionBalanceAudit:{thresholds:{totalAbsoluteDifference:3,sectionAbsoluteDifference:2},totals:{pro,con,absoluteDifference},sections:[{sectionId,pro,con,absoluteDifference}],rationaleRequired,rationale}. Recompute counts; rationale >=40 characters required if either threshold is reached. Explain every asymmetric load-bearing move.

publicationCapacityAudit:{maximumSelectedMovesPerSidePerSection:4,sections:[{sectionId,pro,con,withinCapacity,fourthRowRequired,fourthRowAuthorized,rationale}],allSectionsWithinCapacity:true,allFourthRowsPreauthorized:true}. Fourth row means either side has four. fourthRowAuthorized must be true when justified or vacuously true when no fourth required. Controller independently verifies every count.

fullTranscriptCoverageAudit:{intervals:[{startEvent,endEvent,moveIds,reason}]} partitions ALL original events once in contiguous inclusive intervals. Empty IDs require a source-specific reason: logistics, repetition, incidental/off-motion material, audience-only material or a named frozen exclusion. Explain exclusions honestly without claiming omitted material was judged. All referenced move IDs must exist.

Copy primarySpeakerScopeAudit unchanged from the source; independently confirm no selected span intersects any exclusion. The controller will verify all intervals and intersections before judgment. No credit or penalty for either side from excluded moderator prompts or their directly dependent replies.
